tokens.name: stone-50
tokens.usage: Card and input background; text colour on dark fills (as on-primary).

tokens.name: stone-200
tokens.usage: Quiet panels, selected rows, disabled fill.

tokens.name: stone-300
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decoration only, 1.4:1, never the only cue).

tokens.name: stone-400
tokens.usage: Decorative strokes and placeholder artwork. Never text.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, outline buttons, chips (3.3:1 on stone-100, 3.6:1 on stone-50).

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Disabled text on stone-200 (4.1:1). Never body copy.

tokens.name: stone-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text on stone-100, stone-50 and stone-200 (5.4 to 6.8:1).

tokens.name: stone-800
tokens.usage: Headings on dark hovers; rarely used.

tokens.name: stone-900
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on stone-100 and stone-50 (13.6 to 15:1); toast ground.

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind primary text: hover on secondary buttons, selected tab fill.

tokens.name: olive-800
tokens.usage: Primary: buttons, links, wordmark, headings that carry brand.

tokens.name: brass-100
tokens.usage: Soft ground for the "coming soon" badge.

tokens.name: brass-500
tokens.usage: Brass hairlines and the price-card top rule. Decoration only: 2.7:1 on stone-100, never text.

tokens.name: brass-700
tokens.usage: Small labels and eyebrow text in brass (5.4:1 on stone-100).

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Action gold: the fill of primary buttons, selected chips and the avatar (added 2026-11-07 at the owner's request, brighter than brass-300). Text on it is olive-900 (8.6:1).

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Action gold on hover and while pressed, and the thin border of the action fill. Text on it is olive-900 (6.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on success-surface, surface and bg (6:1 or more). Teal, so it never relies on red versus green. Always with the word or a check icon.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of a success banner. Text on it is success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on warning-surface. Always with the word or an alert icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error borders and icons on surface, bg and danger-surface (5.1 to 6.2:1). Always with the word or an alert icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information text on info-surface (5.4:1). Stone, not blue, so it stays quiet.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text on it: ink, ink-2, link, brass-text, danger.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, inputs, sheets, bottom nav. Text on it: ink, ink-2, link, brass-text, danger, success.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Quiet panel ground. Text on it: ink, ink-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decoration; never the only cue.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Border of any control (input, outline button, chip, checkbox ring). 3.3:1 on bg, 3.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and soft.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper text on bg, surface and soft.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary fill (button, active chip) and the brand ink for the wordmark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover. on-primary stays legible (8.7:1).

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed (14:1 with on-primary).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground for secondary-button hover and selected tab. Text on it: primary (9.8:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on primary, primary-hover, primary-active (8.7 to 14:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Action fill: primary buttons, the selected chip, the account avatar. Text on it is on-action (olive-900, 8.6:1); never white, which is only 1.6:1 on gold.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Action fill on hover and while pressed, and the thin border of the action fill. on-action stays legible (6.9:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the action fill.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass ornament: hairlines, the price-card top rule, selected-tab marker. Decoration only.

tokens.name: brass-text
tokens.usage: Small brass labels and eyebrows on bg, surface and brass-100 (5.4 to 6:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds: 2px solid with 2px offset, so it lands on bg or surface (13.6 to 15:1).

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on dark grounds (toast, dark fills): 15:1 on toast.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on bg and surface (10.3 to 11.3:1). Underlined in running text.
